A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as the '''manager''' and [[Customs official/Legends|customs officer]] of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] spaceport at the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He attempted to make [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] pay a 100 credit docking fee when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived in the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', but Revan convinced him to waive the fee.
